title: A deal can fatten the hand and empty the soul
summary: A deal is false when it enriches the hand and starves the soul. Do not let appetite crowd out what remains.
takeaway: Do not let appetite crowd out what remains.
lifeApplication: When appetite starts calling itself need, stop with your hand on the card or screen and choose the quieter wealth.

source.shortMeaning: A deal is false when it enriches the hand and starves the soul.
source.lifeApplication: Before the next grasping move, ask what can actually travel with the soul.

evidence.coreClaim: A deal is false when it enriches the hand and starves the soul.
evidence.turn: Let this stay with you: pause the deal and choose the profit that can follow you.
evidence.practicalImplication: When appetite starts calling itself need, stop with your hand on the card or screen and choose the quieter wealth.
